theater: 薩摩斯島與尼羅河三角洲外海

battle.name: 希臘的反擊
battle.theater: 薩摩斯島與尼羅河三角洲外海
battle.brief: 公元前487年，雅典先以海軍平定薩摩斯之亂，再集兩百艘三列槳船遠征埃及，欲扶植反波斯的法老阿米爾泰奧斯，把戰場推到波斯腹地；船隊在尼羅河三角洲外海遇風覆沒。希臘人的反擊由此起步，長矛方陣隨後在米卡勒登陸小亞細亞，把戰火推回亞洲。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰的兩邊，一邊是阿契美尼德王朝的波斯帝國，一邊是一個不斷靠廄拼湊起來的希臘城邦聯盟。波斯一方由國王大流士一世在宮廷定下戰略，行省總督薩迪斯的列奧提亞德斯負責日常調度，戰區最高指揮交給軍區總督，第一次遠征是馬爾多尼翁，海路遠征則是達提斯與阿塔斐爾涅斯；愛奧尼亞、埃及與黎凡特各行省的部隊由當地總督徵集，埃及行省一度由法老阿米爾泰奧斯率領反叛。希臘一方以斯巴達為首的伯羅奔尼撒同盟為核心，公元前481年在科林斯召開的會議決定全軍方略，斯巴達的雙王與長老會議掌握戰略決策，各城邦按人口出重裝步兵與騎士，外邦人組成輔兵。雅典以五百人議事會和十人將軍委員會主持海軍，戰時由軍團輪值擔任統帥，公元前478年之後更以同盟海軍統帥的職銜直接指揮提洛同盟的艦隊。聯盟並非一心：科林斯、埃伊那、墨伽拉與雅典各有各的算盤，愛奧尼亞城邦在起義被鎮壓後被編入波斯行省軍，希臘各邦民兵與外邦軍團的編制互不相同，統一指揮全靠科林斯會議的默契維持。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Achaemenid Empire of Persia and a coalition of Greek city-states that had to be improvised as it went. On the Persian side the king Darius I set the strategy at court; the satraps handled day-to-day dispatch, above all Leontiades at Sardis, while command in the theatre was given to a supreme general, Mardonius for the first expedition and Datis with Artaphernes for the naval expedition. Units were raised by the satraps of Ionia, Egypt and the Levant, and the Egyptian satrapy was in open revolt under the pharaoh Amyrtaeus. The Greek side was built around the Peloponnesian League led by Sparta: the congress held at Corinth in 481 BC settled the plan of the whole war, Sparta's dual kings and its council of elders made the strategic decisions, and each polis supplied heavy infantry and cavalry according to its size, with the perioikoi forming the supporting troops. Athens ran its navy through the Council of Five Hundred and the board of ten generals, with a rotating command in wartime, and after 478 BC the title of commander of the allied fleet gave the Athenians direct control over the ships of the Delian League. The coalition was not of one mind: Corinth, Aegina, Megara and Athens each pursued their own interest, the Ionian cities were crushed after the revolt and folded into the satrapal armies, and the militia and perioecic levies of the different poleis were organised on different lines, so that unified command rested on the working agreement of the Corinthian congress.
people: 佩里克利斯是公元前487年那次遠征的策劃者。他先率五十艘三列槳船赴薩摩斯，平定島上的叛亂並圍城九個月，之後率兩百艘三列槳船前往埃及，企圖扶植反對波斯統治的法老阿米爾泰奧斯；船隊在尼羅河三角洲外海遇風散盡，他回國後遭彈劾貪瀆，卻因薩摩斯人與雅典陪審法庭為他作證而獲判無罪，此後他一步步主導雅典的對波斯政策。斯巴達方面有兩位關鍵人物：國王克列奧美涅斯一世在公元前489年率軍遠征阿爾戈斯，事後被控通敵，隨即在公元前487年前後被放逐；列奧提達斯在公元前479年出任聯軍海軍統帥，率軍在米卡勒登陸取勝，隨後又率艦隊進犯色雷斯、圍困塞斯托斯。雅典的克星提普斯與斯巴達人同在米卡勒右翼，最後奪下波斯營寨；米太亞德在馬拉松擊退波斯右翼，忒彌斯托克勒斯在薩拉米斯佈陣，阿里斯泰德主持分贊。波斯方面的關鍵人物是大流士一世批准遠征，馬爾多尼翁在多多卡河戰敗陣亡，列奧提亞德斯在薩迪斯主持鎮壓與重建，希羅多德則在《歷史》中為這段戰事留下唯一的系統記述。
peopleEn: Pericles was the man behind the expedition of 487 BC. He first took fifty triremes to Samos, put down the revolt on the island and kept the town under siege for nine months, and then sailed with two hundred triremes for Egypt in order to support the pharaoh Amyrtaeus against his Persian masters. The fleet was scattered by a storm off the Nile delta; on his return to Athens he was impeached for embezzlement, but the Samians and the Athenian jury gave testimony in his favour and he was acquitted, after which he took over Athenian policy towards Persia step by step. Two Spartan figures matter here. King Cleomenes I led an expedition against Argos in 489 BC, was then accused of treachery and was exiled around 487 BC; Leotychidas served as commander of the allied fleet in 479 BC, landed the army at Mycale and won, and afterwards carried the war into Thrace and up to the siege of Sestos. On the Athenian side Xenophilus fought in the right wing at Mycale alongside the Spartans and finally took the Persian camp, while Miltiades had broken the Persian right wing at Marathon, Themistocles had shaped the line at Salamis and Aristides had presided over the sharing of the spoils. On the Persian side Darius I authorised the expeditions, Mardonius was defeated and killed at the Eurymedon, Leontiades presided over the suppression of the revolt and the rebuilding of Sardis, and Herodotus left the only systematic account of the whole affair in the Histories.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛，是全希臘世界通用的方陣兵器。槍身約兩米，取易劈的白臘木杆，前端是青銅葉形矛頭，槍尾留有金屬尖套，可以插地支撐身體；斯巴達人最倚重它，卡面所示即屬斯巴達型制，但同樣的矛在雅典與伊奧尼亞的方陣裡同樣在用。配套裝備包括科林斯式青銅頭盔、青銅胸甲與脛甲、以木胎蒙皮並鑲金屬飾牌的圓盾，普拉提亞戰後埋入土中的斯巴達圓盾銘文，證實它同時是身份牌與榮譽記錄；短劍只是次要兵器，長矛才是陣中真正殺傷的東西。方陣之外的波斯軍用柳條包覆的藤牌與小型圓盾、木框蒙皮盾、由鱗片與鎖子拼成的甲，武器則是複合弓、箭袋、短矛、投石索用的石彈。海上是另一套裝備：三列槳戰船、五列槳船與各類運輸船，希臘船以銅質撞角和配重槳作戰，遠征隊還需要淡水船、炊事船與載馬的運輸船；攻城時配備撞角、繩梯與木製攻城塔，渡海後還得靠灘頭市集取得淡水。
kitsEn: The Spartan spear on the card is the standard weapon of the phalanx across the whole Greek world. The shaft is about two metres long and cut from straight-grained ash, the head is a bronze leaf-shaped blade, and the butt carries a metal ferrule or spike that could be planted in the ground to brace the body. The Spartans relied on it above all and the specimen on the card is of the Spartan pattern, though the same spear was used in the phalanges of Athens and of the Ionian cities as well. The equipment that went with it consisted of Corinthian bronze helmets, bronze cuirasses and greaves, and the round aspis built on a wooden body covered with hide and faced with metal plates; the inscribed Spartan shields buried in the earth after Plataea show that the shield was at once a badge of identity and a record of honour. The short sword was secondary: the spear was the weapon that actually killed in the line. Outside the phalanx the Persians carried wicker-faced great shields and small round shields of the gerrha type, hide-covered frames, and armour assembled from scales and mail, armed with composite bows, quivers, short spears and sling stones. At sea a different set of equipment applied: triremes, pentekonters and all manner of transports, the Greek ships fighting with bronze rams and weighted oars, while an expedition also needed water casks, galley slaves' supply boats and horse transports, and for sieges the rams, ladders and timber towers needed to work against a wall, with fresh water bought from the beach markets once the fleet had landed.
tactics: 長矛方陣的技術核心在接戰那一刻：步兵重疊七至九排，前排以圓盾互相掩護，長矛從盾縫上方平舉刺出，後排的推進力把整個盾牆推向前方，斯巴達人靠齊整的口令和節奏維持這種推力。薩摩斯海戰示範的是雅典海軍的衝撞術：先以船首撞角擊毀敵舷，再以五列槳船插入敵隊裂縫分割，盡量避免讓對方的三列槳船撞斷自己的槳列。米卡勒登陸戰（公元前479年）則把方陣從防禦轉為攻勢：聯軍先以海軍逐走波斯艦隊，步兵在灘頭列成密集方陣，正面仰攻波斯營寨右翼，波斯軍因地形與陣地受限而失去縱深，聯軍隨即追擊到山麓，攻入營地奪取帳幕與輜重。塞斯托斯圍城（公元前478年）代表另一種戰術：聯軍艦隊封鎖赫勒斯滂海峽渡口，用撞角與工程兵攻城牆，並以封鎖切斷城內波斯守軍的糧食。公元前487年的埃及遠征是典型的兩棲遠征：海軍護送登陸、指望當地盟友接應，一旦失去港口就無力補給，這正是後來全軍覆沒的關鍵。
tacticsEn: The technical core of the spear phalanx lay in the moment of contact: the infantry overlapped in seven to nine ranks, the front ranks covered one another with their round shields, the spears were levelled and thrust over the rim of the shield wall, and the pushing weight of the rear ranks drove the whole wall forward, the Spartans keeping that pressure with shouted cadence and step. The sea fight off Samos demonstrated the ramming tactics of the Athenian navy: strike the enemy's hull with the ram at the bow first, then push lighter pentekonters into the gaps of the enemy line to split it, taking care not to let an enemy trireme break the oar banks of its own ships. The landing at Mycale in 479 BC turned the phalanx from defence into attack: the allied fleet first drove off the Persian ships, the infantry then formed up in a dense phalanx on the beach and assaulted the right wing of the Persian camp uphill, the Persian army losing its depth because of the ground and its narrow camp, and the allies pursued them to the foot of the hills and stormed the camp to take the tents and baggage. The siege of Sestos in 478 BC represents a third method: the allied fleet closed the crossing of the Hellespont, engineers worked on the walls with rams and other devices, and the blockade cut the food of the Persian garrison. The expedition to Egypt in 487 BC was a textbook amphibious operation: the fleet covered the landing and depended on local allies to receive it, and once it lost its harbour it could no longer supply itself, which was the key to the destruction of the whole force.
data: 可核對的數字多來自希羅多德。馬拉松之役（公元前490年），他記波斯軍約二萬五千人、渡海戰船約六百艘，希臘方面約一萬人，陣亡數記為希臘一百九十二人、波斯六千四百人。薩摩斯之役（公元前487年），佩里克利斯先以五十艘三列槳船取勝，圍城九個月後於圍城第三個月迫使薩摩斯投降；其後遠征埃及的船隊為兩百艘三列槳船，風災之後損失過半。米卡勒之役（公元前479年），希羅多德記聯軍步兵約四萬人、戰船約一百二十艘，其中斯巴達及其盟邦兵力最厚。塞斯托斯圍城（公元前478年）自春曬延至冬季，聯軍奪取赫勒斯滂西岸渡口。約公元前466年的歐里梅東河戰役，希臘聯軍在河口以舟橋截斷波斯退路，陸上同時擊退波斯軍。航程方面，自愛琴海至埃及沿黎凡特海岸約二千公里，遠征隊需數週才到。提洛同盟的貢金按年徵收，頭一年總額以數百塔蘭特計，其中一半存入德洛斯的聖庫，一半撥作海軍軍費。古代史料並未記下薩摩斯出兵的確切月份，學界多置於公元前487年的春夏航季，本卡取四月以代表開赴薩摩斯之時節。
dataEn: Most of the figures that can be checked come from Herodotus. For Marathon in 490 BC he gives a Persian army of about twenty-five thousand men crossing in about six hundred ships against roughly ten thousand Greeks, with a Greek loss of a hundred and ninety-two men and a Persian loss of six thousand four hundred. In the Samos campaign of 487 BC Pericles first won with fifty triremes, and after nine months of siege forced Samos to surrender in the third month of the blockade; the fleet that afterwards sailed for Egypt numbered two hundred triremes and lost more than half of its strength in the storm. For Mycale in 479 BC Herodotus gives an allied infantry of about forty thousand and about one hundred and twenty ships, with the Spartans and their allies the thickest contingent. The siege of Sestos in 478 BC ran from the spring sailing season into the winter and gave the allies the crossing on the western shore of the Hellespont. At the Eurymedon, around 466 BC, the allies cut the Persian retreat with a bridge of boats at the river mouth while beating them on land as well. As for distance, the run from the Aegean to Egypt along the Levantine coast is about two thousand kilometres and took the expedition several weeks. The Delian League assessed its tribute year by year, the first year's total running to several hundred talents, of which half was put in the treasury at Delos and half set aside for the war at sea. The ancient sources do not record the exact month in which the Samian expedition sailed, and modern scholarship usually places it in the spring and summer sailing season of 487 BC, so the month on this card, April, stands for the sailing of the fleet towards Samos.
cause: 希臘人之所以能在公元前487年把矛頭指向埃及，源於此前五十年的連續打擊。公元前499年開始的伊奧尼亞起義最終失敗：米利都陷落，雅典派兵助戰卻在薩迪斯縱火焚城，把波斯逼到必須回應的位置；公元前492年的第一次遠征因色雷斯的暴風與阿索斯山的慘敗而無功而返，卻加深了希臘人對波斯陸軍的恐懼。公元前490年馬拉松的勝利讓希臘人第一次相信可以正面擊退波斯大軍，但遠征並未就此罷手。公元前480至479年的第二次遠征席捲希臘本土，薩拉米斯海戰與普拉提亞陸戰把波斯逐出希臘城邦，卻也燒掉了雅典的衛城與城牆，兵員折損慘重，恐懼反而加深。直接動因還有內部政治：斯巴達主導的聯盟缺乏長征亞洲的資源與意願，雅典則希望藉一場持久海戰把同盟的財富與城邦控制權集中到自己手上，佩里克利斯用支援埃及法老的名義，把遠征說成是替被波斯統治的民族解脫。於是一次純粹的防守戰，在公元前487年被改寫成反擊。
causeEn: The Greeks could point their spears at Egypt in 487 BC only because of fifty years of continuous pressure behind them. The Ionian revolt that began in 499 BC ended in failure: Miletus fell, the Athenians who came to help had burnt Sardis, and the Persians were driven to the position of having to answer. The first expedition of 492 BC came to nothing because of a storm off Thrace and the disaster at Mount Athos, and it deepened Greek fear of the Persian infantry. The victory at Marathon in 490 BC let the Greeks believe for the first time that a Persian army could be beaten in the open, but the war was not over. The second invasion of 480 and 479 BC swept through Greece itself; the naval action at Salamis and the battle at Plataea drove the Persians out of the Greek city-states, but the burning of the Athenian citadel and the heavy losses in Athenian ranks left fear deeper than before. The immediate motive also lay in domestic politics: the Spartan-led coalition lacked the resources and the will for a long march into Asia, while Athens wanted a long naval war to concentrate the wealth of the alliance and the control of its members in its own hands, and Pericles used the cause of the Egyptian pharaoh to dress the expedition up as a war of liberation for peoples under Persian rule. A war of pure defence was thus, in 487 BC, rewritten as a counterattack.
impact: 反擊的最大後果，是把一個臨時防禦聯盟改造成常態化的攻勢同盟。公元前478年聯盟定都德洛斯，開始以同盟名義向愛奧尼亞、小亞細亞與色雷斯派出艦隊；公元前454年聖庫遷往雅典，貢金與艦隊指揮權集中，提洛同盟逐步變成雅典的海上帝國，愛奧尼亞城邦在戰後被重新編入聯盟並接受雅典的駐軍與制度。波斯方面，西利西亞與小亞細亞的戰線被推回亞細亞內陸，薩迪斯與波斯腹地之間的補給線長期受騷擾，希臘人心中的奪回薩迪斯、燒掉佩爾薩玻利斯成為跨越三百年的訴求，直到公元前330年亞歷山大焚毀佩爾薩玻利斯才算了結。方法論上的影響更持久：方陣與海軍兩套武器系統被系統化，長期戰爭逼出造船、財政與後勤的制度，也催生了同盟者城邦的財政依賴；公民兵裝備標準化，兵役與戰費的負擔改變了城邦政治，古典時期的公民戰爭倫理由此定型。這段戰爭後來被羅馬人與近代民族主義者反覆引用為文明對抗野蠻的範例。
impactEn: The great consequence of the counterattack was that a temporary defensive coalition became a permanent offensive one. In 478 BC the league fixed its seat at Delos and began sending fleets in the name of the alliance into Ionia, Asia Minor and Thrace; when the treasury was moved to Athens in 454 BC the tribute and the command of the ships were concentrated in one place, and the Delian League gradually became an Athenian maritime empire, the Ionian cities being re-enrolled after the war and put under Athenian garrisons and institutions. On the Persian side the fronts in Cilicia and Asia Minor were pushed back inland, the supply line between Sardis and the Persian heartland was harried for years, and the Greek dream of taking Sardis and burning Persepolis became a grievance that lasted three centuries and was only settled when Alexander burnt Persepolis in 330 BC. The methodological effect was more durable still: the phalanx and the navy were systematised as two weapons systems, and a long war forced institutions of shipbuilding, finance and supply into existence, together with the financial dependence of the subject cities on the alliance. Citizen equipment was standardised, the burden of service and of war costs reshaped polis politics, and the classical ethic of the citizen war was fixed in this period. Later Roman writers, and modern nationalists after them, kept returning to these wars as the model of civilisation arrayed against barbarism.
result: 公元前487年的開場動作以失敗收場：薩摩斯之亂被平定，埃及船隊在尼羅河三角洲外海遇風覆沒，佩里克利斯被判無罪，希臘人的第一次反擊甚至沒有踏上埃及的灘頭。真正的轉折在公元前479年：聯軍在米卡勒登陸成功，波斯海軍被逐出愛琴海，波斯在亞洲西端的營壘被攻破，戰爭由守土變成收復失地。公元前478年塞斯托斯落入聯軍之手，赫勒斯滂海峽的渡口控制成為波斯與希臘爭奪的關鍵；約公元前466年歐里梅東河一戰，波斯在愛琴海東岸的據點陸續被拔除，希臘艦隊一度駛到小亞細亞內陸的薩迪斯城下。公元前449年卡里亞斯和約簽訂，波斯承認小亞細亞沿海希臘城邦的自主，承諾不再越過愛琴海東岸用兵，希臘也承認波斯在亞洲的現狀。反擊因此以換取承認收場，而不是以攻陷波斯腹地收場：希臘人守住了本土，卻沒有走到蘇薩、佩爾薩玻利斯與巴比倫，那些戰果要留給亞歷山大。留下來的還有一份沉重的帳單：同盟貢金與常備艦隊的開支最終壓垮雅典的財政，斯巴達則一直主張放棄亞洲戰線，兩者的分歧在公元前431年變成了伯羅奔尼撒戰爭。
resultEn: The opening move of 487 BC ended in failure: the revolt of Samos was put down, the Egyptian fleet was wrecked by a storm off the Nile delta, Pericles was acquitted, and the first Greek counterattack never set foot on the Egyptian shore. The real turning point came in 479 BC, when the allies landed successfully at Mycale, drove the Persian fleet out of the Aegean and broke the Persian camp at the western end of Asia, so that the war changed from a defence of the homeland into a recovery of lost ground. In 478 BC Sestos fell to the allies, and control of the crossing of the Hellespont became the key point contended between Persians and Greeks; after the Eurymedon around 466 BC the Persian positions on the eastern shore of the Aegean were picked off one by one, and Greek ships at times appeared before Sardis in the interior of Asia Minor. In 449 BC the Peace of Callias was concluded: Persia recognised the autonomy of the Greek cities along the coast of Asia Minor and promised not to carry its forces across the eastern shore of the Aegean again, and the Greeks in turn accepted the Persian position in Asia. The counterattack therefore ended in a bargain for recognition rather than in the sack of the Persian heartland: the Greeks held their homeland, but never reached Susa, Persepolis or Babylon, and those prizes were left to Alexander. What remained was a heavy bill: the tribute and the standing fleets eventually strained Athenian finances to breaking point, while Sparta had argued all along for abandoning the Asian theatre, and the disagreement between the two became the Peloponnesian War in 431 BC.
